new_batch_highlights: Ngwi ordering: Proto-Bantu 7>5 merger precedes conditioned *i centralization; final-vowel loss removes the conditioning V2 and phonologizes /ə, ɤ/.
Ngwi lexical diffusion is retained explicitly: suitable *i>ə targets can escape and the change can extend irregularly outside its conditioning environment.
Ngwi vowel-sequence chains preserve pre-NC lengthening, NC reduction, long-vowel diphthongization, syllabification, intervocalic consonant loss, exceptions, and the competing dissimilation analysis.
Lower Kasai FVL is seriated after intervocalic consonant/NC loss and classified by systematic/pervasive/frequent lexical penetration rather than flattened into one categorical event.

Lower Kasai contact history is represented as two proposed stages (substrate-associated emergence, then dialect diffusion), with Bushong prestige diffusion kept as a separately attributed historical hypothesis.
